observations: Four-door refrigerator, French-door style with two top doors and two bottom doors.
Interior shows styrofoam packaging and blue protective tape, suggesting it is new or open-box.
Top section has wide glass shelves and door-mounted bins.
Bottom section features multiple pull-out freezer drawers.
A watermark for 'GREEN LEAF ELECTRONICS' is visible across the center.
The background shows other boxed appliances, suggesting a retail environment.
No brand name or model number is visible on the unit in the photo.

claims.evidence: This likely refers to cooling retention during power outages, which cannot be tested remotely.
Refers to internal cooling coils which are not visible.
Requires a photo of the stamped warranty card or a formal receipt from the seller.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker (usually found inside the fridge wall or on the back).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic, no-name brand of the smallest equivalent size.

risks.proof: A video showing the internal lights and digital display (if any) powered on, and a thermometer showing a drop in temperature.
Photos of the front doors closed and both side panels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having significant dents or scratches.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate/sticker showing the model and brand.
Photos of the refrigerator with the doors closed to see the exterior condition.
Photo of the warranty document mentioned in the description.
Video of the unit plugged in and running.
response.reason: The brand and model are essential for valuing a large appliance. Without the manufacturer's label, the capacity and technical specifications cannot be determined.
